content.title: Live Blog: Bosnia vs Italy LIVE UEFA playoff final for 2026 World Cup
content.text: FIFA World Cup03/31/2026 - 06:44 PM - by Miguel CalixtoThe Bosnia and Herzegovina national team and Italy face off in the UEFA playoff final for a place at the 2026 World Cup.Bosnia is in the 2026 World Cup Italy had a forgettable penalty shootout and will miss out for the third consecutive World CupBosnia vs. Italy ends After a 1-1 draw in regulation and extra time, it will go to penalties.Goal for Bosnia 79 Haris Tabaković pounces on rebounds and sends the game into overtimeBosnia presses, Italy holds firm The Bosnians deserved a draw, but Moise Kean missed a golden opportunity to double their lead on a counter-attack.Half-time Italy leads Bosnia 1-0, but they're down to ten men.Italy sent off! Donnarumma makes a mistake, Bastoni goes for the tackle and is sent off. HOLY SH*T ALESSANDRO BASTONI ITALY RECEIVES A RED CARD IN JUST THE 42nd MINUTE OF A CRUCIAL WORD CUP QUALIFYING GAME!!!!!ANOTHER ARAUJO pic.twitter.com/BFzSMQiUnh— LIVE GOALS (@FTLiveGoals) March 31, 2026 This was the atmosphere in Bosnia before the match against Italy Goal for Italy 15' A gift from the Bosnian goalkeeper and Moise Kean makes it 1-0The match is being played in Bosnia. Italy is seeking its return to the World Cup, in 2026.The Bosnia and Herzegovina national team and Italy face off in the UEFA playoff final for a place at the 2026 World Cup.Gennaro Gattuso’s side are fighting to return to the World Cup after missing the last two editions.The match takes place at Stadion Bilino Polje. What happens if Bosnia vs Italy ends in a draw? Bosnia arrive after defeating Wales, while Italy beat Northern Ireland to reach this final.If the match is tied after 90 minutes, it will go to extra time and penalties to determine the winner.Predicted lineups for Bosnia vs Italy Bosnia and Herzegovina: Nikola Vasilj Amar Dedic Nikola Katic Tarik Muharemovic Sead Kolasinac Esmir Bajraktarevic Ivan Basic Benjamin Tahirovic Amar Memic Edin Dzeko Ermedin Demirovic Italy Gianluigi Donnarumma Gianluca Mancini Alessandro Bastoni Riccardo Calafiori Matteo Politano Nicoló Barella Manuel Locatelli Sandro Tonali Federico Dimarco Moise Kean Mateo Retegui FIFA World Cup
